sourceSheet: イバトコ SEO・流入データ / Strategy_Scorecard

currentRisks.evidence: 519 returning sessions / 5316 classified new+returning sessions in 2026-09-03..09-30 (9.76%)
28 outbound booking clicks in 2026-09-24..09-30; confirmed revenue 0; monetized click share remains missing
/place/ infrastructure exists but no published verified stores
daily OS depends on Windsor.ai direct connection plus Google Sheet fallback

guardrails: Do not optimize page views alone.
Do not treat generate_lead as paid business lead without classification.
Do not treat estimated revenue as confirmed revenue.
Do not repeatedly modify the same page before the observation window closes unless facts are wrong.
Do not silently infer data when connectors fail.
Do not build large products before demand evidence.
Do not let GSC-only discovery hide queries where Ibatoco has zero current impressions.
Do not evaluate local business pages by page views alone; track real outbound actions.
Do not count editorial/contributor contacts as paid B2B pipeline.
Do not persist customer personal data in the public GitHub repository.
Do not accelerate monetization by weakening disclosure, rights, privacy, accessibility, or security.

lensDecisions.reason: Organic Search is 89.51% of recent 7-day sessions; GA4 Views grew 15.45% but the 28-day run-rate is only 8,788 against the 100,000 target.
The daily 3-5 article quota was stopped by owner decision. Publish news only when search demand, deadline, practical value or distribution upside exceeds seasonal growth work.
Organic Social is measurable but small; redistribute proven search themes without adding paid tools.
English title experiment started 2026-09-24 and remains inside its observation window.
Returning session share is 9.76%. External account or delivery infrastructure requires approval; no new platform is created automatically.
Allocate production to November large-demand clusters and evergreen transport utility, not low-demand daily news volume.
GrowthNext reached 1,267 views and 67 clicks (5.29% CTR); Views/session improved 7.57%. Freeze through the 2026-10-04 gate.
28 booking clicks show intent, but provider-level monetized share and confirmed revenue remain missing; do not add unapproved links.
266 CTA views and zero clicks identify the bottleneck, but the homepage changed on 2026-10-01 and is inside its observation window.
Verified published place inventory is still zero; do not scale an empty directory.
No approved sponsor inventory or commercial terms; preserve editorial independence.
36 event records, 86 event/guide pages and 19 growth opportunities are compounding structured assets; no large product build yet.
Test whether original event logistics summaries earn official/local citations before building outreach.
Rights, moderation and contributor governance are not yet ready for scale.
News sitemap, NewsArticle and 1200x630 card infrastructure are in place; verify every deploy.
GA4 9/30 normalized while 10/1 is an incomplete anomaly; rolling confirmation and backfill remain required.
Date, weekday and event-status correctness remain immediate-fix controls.
Direct Windsor reads and Drive readback both succeeded; keep production-browser verification as a hard gate.
Confirmed revenue is 0; gross profit, labor hours and Revenue/hour are missing. Do not infer economics from clicks.
Editorial registry, action queue and specifications reduce implicit founder knowledge, but commercial approval and external account work still depend on the owner.

stopOrHold: Do not change GrowthNext before the 2026-10-04 scheduled gate despite passing the interim threshold.
Do not expand akippa links beyond the registered event URL without confirmed approval and exact affiliate URLs.
Do not expand /place/ until verified businesses exist.
Do not alter the English title experiment before its 14-day review.

founderDependence.evidence: OS・仕様・台帳・CIは再現可能。価格・契約・営業・外部アカウント・権利判断はオーナー承認が必要。運用工数はmissing。

businessModelReview.decision: 11月10万PVへ60%を大型季節検索へ集中。収益は確定成果が出るまで未確認値を計上せず、承認済み導線だけ維持する。
